answer: Each identity joins one jetty pool of ten in the yarrow ledger, and locks a 90 credit bond. Pools admit only members with a prior jetty delivery, and one crystal key joins one pool only. If the crystal auditor proves a member fake, the whole pool burns: one hit costs 900, not 90. The m-th fake raises its pool's loss to m times 90, so a full fake pool risks 900 per hit. A thousand fakes lock 90,000 across 100 pools. A pool-stuffing ring fails: one proven fake burns the pool, and the yarrow map freezes sibling pools sharing a key. An honest agent pays 90 once, refunded on clean exit.
